new_content.name: Bagged Villager
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shift-right-click a villager while holding a Bundle.
new_content.notes: Stores the villager and its trades. Use it on the ground to place the villager back; the item turns back into a plain Bundle.

new_content.name: Pied Piper
new_content.how_to_obtain: Advancement: lure 8 villagers to you at the same time.

mechanics.title: Pack configuration (villagertweaks.json5)
mechanics.description: Max trade override: off (vanilla trade limits). Demand modifier: on (heavily traded offers get pricier, as in vanilla). Global reputation: off (reputation is per player). Negative reputation: on (hitting or killing villagers lowers reputation). Zombie conversion: forced on, so zombies always convert villagers instead of killing them regardless of difficulty. Cure time: overridden to a fixed 3600 ticks (3 minutes) and the remaining time is displayed. Emerald temptation: on, villagers follow you while you hold an emerald block, emerald ore or deepslate emerald ore.

mechanics.title: Options left at defaults
mechanics.description: Max-discount cap (off), grow-up time override and display (off), leashing nitwits (off).

vanilla_changes.change: Zombies always convert villagers rather than killing them, and cured zombie villagers take a fixed 3600 ticks (3 minutes) with a displayed countdown.
Villagers follow players holding an emerald block, emerald ore or deepslate emerald ore.

qol: Move villagers with a Bundle instead of boats or minecarts.
getting_started: Hold a Bundle and shift-right-click a villager to bag it; use the Bagged Villager on the ground to release it.
editor_notes: Config is also editable via YACL/Mod Menu. Demand modifier on means vanilla price behavior is kept.
name: VillagerTweaks
summary: The pack author's mod with small villager quality-of-life changes: a Bundle-based way to carry villagers, plus configurable trading, reputation and zombie-cure rules. In this pack, zombies always convert villagers, cures take a fixed 3 minutes with a visible timer, and villagers follow players holding emerald items.
